core_relation.sentence: The entire framework depends on a single axiom — the Trinitarian God as self-grounding ground — from which existence, distinction, relation, and orientation are derived, and through which physics becomes the created medium where love, choice, consequence, time, repair, and grace can be publicly real.
core_relation.quote: One axiom. Four debts paid. Everything else derives from this through formal grammar constrained by physics. [S037-S039]

product_test.quote: If God COULD be proven, God would not be the ground. [S045]
product_test.reason: The paper explicitly treats the root axiom as non-optional: if the Trinitarian ground is removed or zeroed, the four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) are unpaid and the entire derivation grammar collapses. The logic is conjunctive, not additive — every downstream claim depends on the axiom holding.

slots.plays_role: The external negentropy influx is God as the necessary, self-grounding source that sustains a universe which would otherwise run down; grace enters from beyond the closed system.
slots.quote: If closed systems collapse and the universe has not collapsed, then something external sustains it. [S290]

slots.plays_role: Alignment is love as the ground-state coupling between the Trinitarian persons and the orientation of creation toward God; the system is aligned when it is rightly related to its source.
slots.quote: Love: the ground state of the coupling between them. [S022]

slots.plays_role: Signal fidelity is truth, the Word, and information that survives transmission — light never degrades in transit, and revelation is the signal God transmits to creatures.
slots.quote: Never degrades in transit -- a photon from 13 billion years ago arrives with its original information intact. [S159]

slots.plays_role: Effective entropy is the Second Law and the decay of closed systems; it is what lowers coherence and makes grace necessary.
slots.quote: The Second Law: entropy always increases in a closed system. You cannot cheat it. [S164-S165]

slots.plays_role: Temporal integration is time as the medium of covenant, sequence, patience, hope, and the progressive revelation that builds a reference frame over history.
slots.quote: Time is not a prison. It is the medium of covenant. [S095-S096]

slots.plays_role: Compression is the Logos — the ordered language and formal grammar through which the infinite God is compressed into intelligible law, story, and equation.
slots.quote: Physics is the grammar of that world. It is not the Author. It is the ordered language the Author speaks... [S069-S071]

slots.plays_role: Phase transition is the cross and resurrection: a threshold event where entropy is locally reversed and the system changes state rather than degree.
slots.quote: Second: entropy -- the rule that everything falls apart when left alone -- gets locally reversed by connecting the system to a source outside itself. [S223]

slots.plays_role: Superposition is open possibility and genuine agency — the unresolved capacity to choose, refuse, or receive, which must be actualized by free will.
Non-local correlation is perichoresis and the entanglement-like mutual indwelling of the Trinitarian persons, and by extension the constitutive relation between God and creation.
slots.quote: Relation is perichoresis -- the persons indwell each other constitutively. [S035]

slots.plays_role: Integration is the local integrator: the Trinitarian structure itself as the single axiom that integrates existence, distinction, relation, and orientation into one coherent ground.
slots.quote: The Trinity pays all four from one structure. [S032]

breaks: The paper treats 'agency' as a required extra factor with no dedicated slot in the master equation; it is the repeated missing piece in all ten law mappings, but the canonical slot list has no A for agency.

The paper's product test is stated for the root axiom, not for the full χ product; several downstream factors (e.g., physics as medium) are described as necessary conditions rather than multiplicative contributors.
The slot K (compression) is only analogically present: the paper speaks of grammar, language, and Logos, but does not frame this as compression or compressibility in the Shannon sense.
The slot Q (superposition) is stretched: the paper's 'open possibility' is theological agency, not quantum superposition, and the paper does not use quantum formalism to ground it.

The paper adds 'narrative' and 'progressive revelation' as a temporal pedagogy that has no direct slot; it functions as a meta-factor shaping how T is received rather than as a separate multiplicative term.
extra_factors: Agency — the capacity to receive or refuse, named as the repeated structural gap in all ten law mappings (S246-S250).
Narrative / progressive revelation — God building a reference frame over time so receivers can parse the signal (S343-S354).
Cross-Resolution Method — a meta-method for testing claims across theology, physics, mathematics, lived reality, and bridge registers (S276-S288).
parsed.one_line: The paper's single Trinitarian axiom functions as a multiplicative root for a χ-like product in which God supplies G, M, E, S_eff, T, R, F, and C, while agency and narrative appear as extra factors the canonical slots do not name.
